title: The Daily Grind – Salted Caramel Cappuccino 100ML
description:
The Daily Grind – Salted Caramel Cappuccino 100ML
Get ahead of the daily grind with an invigorating selection of coffee house vape juice. Every bit as creamy and delicious as the real thing, these fresh cafe-style flavours are developed in the UK, produced in Australia.
The Daily Grind Salted Caramel Cappuccino is a delicious blend of toffee nut syrup and fresh coffee, with creamy milk and whipped cream; mixed with a sweet and salty caramel sauce.
Primary Flavours
: Coffee, Sweet and Salty Caramel Sauce
PG/VG Ratio:
70 VG / 30 PG
Bottle Sizes:
100ml
Nicotine:
0 MG
